summary: InspireMD, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 1, 2026, disclosing a voluntary recall of its CGuard Prime 135 cm carotid stent delivery system in the U.S. due to unmet performance expectations during controlled launch, and FDA approval of an IDE for its SwitchGuard NPS pivotal study. No transaction, activist, or restructuring event is involved; the filing covers operational product recall and regulatory update. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor are mentioned. Watch for potential revenue impact and regulatory outcomes but no special-situation catalyst.
